summary: Bilibili Inc. filed a 6-K announcing pricing of US$700 million convertible senior notes due 2031, including a US$200 million Tencent subscription, alongside a concurrent equity placement and share repurchases. The notes carry an initial conversion price of ~HK$155.79 per share, a ~28.3% premium over the HK$121.40 closing price, and ~35% over the placement reference price of HK$115.38. Proceeds fund repurchases, AI growth, and general purposes. The company may redeem notes after September 2029 under certain conditions. Watch conversion dynamics and share buyback execution for risk-arb opportunities.
